recap:sandbachFocus.text: Sandbach United maintained their excellent form with a hard-fought 2-0 home victory over fourth-placed Eccleshall on Saturday. Josh Fowles opened the scoring early in the first half, and despite Eccleshall pressing hard in the second half—particularly after Sandbach's Hatton was sin-binned—the Ramblers held firm to secure the three points. The win extends Sandbach's unbeaten run, though they remain level on 19 points with AFC Bridgnorth and Stafford Town at the top of the table.

fanBriefing.text: Sandbach United recently featured in a new football management game, giving fans the chance to take the club to the top of the non-league system.  Outside of the virtual football OConnell, Foley and Hatton have been leading the way in terms of goals but Fowles has also been in form and all will be keen to add to their tally against a struggling Alsager side that will be keen to prove themselves in a cup game under new management. Sandbach will be looking to build on their recent progress as the campaign continues.
